masterMoulds.name: Column Quarter Shell
masterMoulds.description: Cast-stone quarter shell. 4 per column node, interlocking via steel plate + pin.

masterMoulds.name: Ribbed Vault Fragment
masterMoulds.description: Doubly-curved vault panel. 2–4 per ceiling bay. Nested mould geometry.

masterMoulds.name: Service Core Monolith
masterMoulds.description: Precast geopolymer. Single pour. Houses all MEP verticals.

masterMoulds.name: Ribbed Slab Deck Panel
masterMoulds.description: Post-tensioned slab deck. Span up to 6m. Cast flat, rotated on install.

masterMoulds.name: Foundation Anchor Pad
masterMoulds.description: Seismic anchor pad. Cast in-situ with rebar dowels. Ground-bearing.

masterMoulds.name: Solid Wall Panel
masterMoulds.description: Opaque enclosure panel. Full-height. Fixed via concealed channel.

masterMoulds.name: Fenestrated Panel
masterMoulds.description: Wall panel with integrated window rebate. Glazing unit installed post-erection.

masterMoulds.name: Balcony Cantilever Slab
masterMoulds.description: Cantilevered balcony. Max 1.5m projection. Bolted to slab deck edge plate.

castingSequence.label: Mould Assembly
castingSequence.desc: Set mould shuttering, apply release agent, insert rebar cage and PT ducts.

castingSequence.label: Material Batching
castingSequence.desc: Weigh marble dust, GGBS, Portland cement, basalt fibres. Mix dry. Add water + superplasticiser.

castingSequence.label: Pour & Vibrate
castingSequence.desc: Pour slurry. Table-vibrate to full consolidation. Screed flush.

castingSequence.label: Curing Dwell
castingSequence.desc: Cover with polythene. Maintain 20°C for minimum dwell period per mould spec.

castingSequence.label: Demould & Finish
castingSequence.desc: Strip shutters. Check surface. Apply dry-stone bush-hammer finish where specified.
